rules: Comando di 2-3 parole, una sola parola in rosso
Un solo soggetto, grande, tagliato dal bordo
Sfondo nero puro o rosso pieno
Nessun testo piccolo: si deve leggere a 170x95 pixel
Il testo ripete il comando del titolo oppure apre una domanda, non aggiunge altre frasi

ai.style_prompt: Flat 2D vector illustration for a YouTube horror thumbnail. Thick black outlines, clean solid colors, pure white characters, one red accent, minimal detail, very high contrast, simple rounded shapes like a motion-graphics pictogram, very expressive face. Crisp hard edges, no outer glow, no drop shadow, no gradients. No text, no letters, no logo, no watermark.
ai.background: Isolated on a perfectly flat solid magenta (#FF00FF) background with no shadows on the background.
ai.negative: photo, realistic, 3D render, gradient background, text, caption, watermark, extra fingers, blood, gore

double_grin.prompt: Head-and-shoulders bust of a round-headed white pictogram character wearing a red scarf, but it is the evil double: glowing red eyes, angry slanted black eyebrows, a very wide grin full of square white teeth. Cropped at the bottom edge, facing the viewer.

double_red.prompt: Head-and-shoulders bust of a round-headed bright red monster with round white eyes, small black pupils, angry black eyebrows and a wide grin with white teeth, facing the viewer, cropped at the bottom.

you_scared.prompt: Head-and-shoulders bust of a round-headed white pictogram character with a red scarf, looking worried to the right, a sweat drop on the forehead, small black dot eyes, cropped at the bottom.
